serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Big Daddy: This place is pretty close. I guess we could’ve gone there on foot, but I’m kinda short on time. Wife is nagging me about something.
You: Is everything alright between you two?
Big Daddy: Of course! Why wouldn't it be?! It’s not like I’m avoiding her or something, our schedules are just packed! That’s all!
You: Alright…
Big Daddy: She’s probably kinda mad about me skipping the counseling again. It’s not my fault, really. You know what I mean, right?!
I have no idea what he means, but he seems kinda agitated about it so…
You: Y-yeah, I get it! Totally! 
Big Daddy: I knew you would get it! My man!
Big Daddy: We are already at the place, let’s go!
